description: Create or update products in the catalog (Commerce API, keyed by your productId, stored under the api provider). Use this to add products that are not synced from Stripe/Shopify/WooCommerce, then attach a deliverable file with attach_product_file and build a purchase sequence for them.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

inStock.description: Whether the product is in stock.

priceCents.description: Price in the smallest currency unit.

productId.description: Your stable product identifier (used for upserts and order line items).

providerCreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 creation time from the source catalog. Omit to preserve the stored value; pass null to clear it. Used for newest-product ranking.

name: upsert_products

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `upsert_products` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

products.description: List of product records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
